structuralIssues.answerPositionBias: Stored bank: 230/365 correct answers are option B (63%), 12/365 option D (3%). Test flows now shuffle options; the stored data is unchanged.
structuralIssues.longestOptionTell: ~30% of questions have the correct option as the clearly longest - authors should balance option lengths.
structuralIssues.weakDistractors: Several questions use absurd distractors (e.g. 'Ignoring venue safety', 'Only announcing the winner'); these test test-taking, not knowledge.
structuralIssues.sourcesAreGenericTitles: The 'source' field names a textbook/area, not an edition or page. Do not present it as a citation.
